# Course-status legend (current_course.status)

The practical course a bearing reports. Same set in the webapp + the bearing schema.

- **proceed** — Act on the current course — no load-bearing reason to change.
- **hold** — Do not execute yet — a repair or human check must come first.
- **fork** — A genuine load-bearing decision with a real alternative pole.
- **anchor** — Stay put — every named axis is already satisfied; no fork to work.
- **revise** — The agent team should revise before boss/user signoff.
- **collect_evidence** — Blocked on external/human evidence before the course can be set.
